text: Added Added skills from MCP servers (beta). They show as server:skill in the / menu; other skills keep their names Added a PreSkillShellCommand hook event that can refuse a skill or command's inline shell commands as it loads; on 2.1.331 and older, a settings file naming it opens a dialog at start Added "Always deliver" to the prompt for held messages from other sessions Added a footer line that stays while a flagged message has your session on a different model, until you pick one with /model Added an OpenTelemetry assistant_response event for text Claude sends through SendUserMessage or Cowork's message tool, when response logging is on Added a warning in VS Code and Desktop's Code tab when part of a session couldn't be saved, saying how to save it with /compact Added a notice in VS Code and Desktop's Code tab when a resumed session's earlier messages weren't loaded, as the terminal already shows Added your Cyber Verification Program access tier to the startup header, beside the model name when your tier applies to that model and you're signed in with a claude.ai account [VSCode] Added a notification in more cases when closing a proposed diff leaves the edit unapplied, and stopped the diff notifications on a split copy of an answered diff [VSCode] Added a warning when restoring a conversation with /rewind in the side bar stops a self-paced /loop [VSCode] Added the installed version to the rows of Manage plugins Changed Updated computer use on macOS to newer safety rules, so some actions are refused and typing can be slower Changed terminal and VS Code sessions moved to Sonnet 5 or 5.5 on Bedrock Mantle, Agent Platform and Foundry to start in auto mode if no mode is set; set disableAutoMode to "disable" to stop it Changed the sonnet model alias on Google Cloud's Agent Platform and Microsoft Foundry to Sonnet 5.5, and Foundry's opus alias to Opus 5.5; sonnet on Amazon Bedrock stays at Sonnet 4.5 Changed the default model on Microsoft Foundry to Sonnet 5.5: deploy claude-sonnet-5-5, or set ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL to a model you have deployed Changed sonnet and background requests on Google Cloud's Agent Platform to read VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_5_5_SONNET; with only the 4_5 variable set they go to CLOUD_ML_REGION or us-east5 Changed --model default and a Default pick to move to an older model when that model isn't available, instead of stopping with an error; in auto mode, only to a model auto mode accepts Changed Microsoft Foundry: Claude Sonnet 4, Opus 4 and Opus 4.1 now count as retired, so step-downs stop above them and a pin to one warns that it was retired Changed the Claude apps gateway's built-in model list: Sonnet 5.5 replaces Sonnet 4.5 as its second model, and Claude Desktop starts on it where a policy allows no Opus 4.6 Changed SDK and claude -p mid-turn messages to count as the user's where feature flags aren't fetched, as on clouds or with telemetry off, from Opus 4.8 on; mark relayed text isSynthetic: true Changed computer-use to a reserved skill name on Macs with computer use on: your own skill or command of that name stops loading, and a start-up notice says to rename it Changed the default OpenTelemetry service.name of desktop Code tab sessions to claude-code-desktop; update filters keyed on claude-code, or set OTEL_SERVICE_NAME to keep the old name Changed OpenTelemetry tool_input to show only the length of text sent through SendUserMessage or Cowork's message tool, unless response logging is on (OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1) Self-hosted runner: Changed CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: its prefix can now end in oat02- as well as oat01-. Update proxy rules and log scrubbers that match oat01-, and mask the whole value Changed claude self-hosted-runner setup with no arguments on macOS and Linux to ask for the environment key in the terminal before Claude starts, and to hide it as you paste Changed Claude Desktop's Code tab on Anthropic's API to ignore default, side-request, alias and subagent model ids not starting with claude in your own settings beside a gateway address Changed Claude Desktop's Code tab on Anthropic's API to ignore a CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW under 200K in your own settings beside a gateway address; use /autocompact instead Changed plan mode in the desktop app's Code tab and VS Code to ask for approval instead of refusing when no auto mode safety check can judge a command, for plans entered from Manual or Accept edits Changed PgUp and Home to go to No on destructive questions, such as /clear from an agent's view Changed /feedback drafts in the terminal to open on Not now, above separate rows to send the report alone or with the transcript Changed tap-mode voice dictation to keep the microphone on until 60 seconds without new words or 10 minutes, up from 15 seconds and 2 minutes, then keep the text unsent; the next tap adds to it Changed tap-mode voice dictation to stop when you send the prompt, and to stop and say why when you edit it, a panel covers it, or the connection or a separate recorder program is lost Changed /schedule, permission prompts and /loop's cloud offer to say "cloud scheduled task" instead of "routine" or "cloud schedule"; /routines still works Changed model switches from the Claude mobile app or claude.ai to keep the effort level you saved for the previous model when none is saved for the new one Changed the hint a mod's PromptHint hook receives to leave out the hint for selected text when the fullscreen footer has a label on its right Changed awsCredentialExport to time out after 10 minutes instead of waiting forever [VSCode] Changed voice dictation to stop by itself after 60 seconds without recognized speech or 10 minutes, up from 15 seconds and 2 minutes, so the microphone can stay on longer [VSCode] Changed voice dictation to stop, and say why, when the microphone stops sending audio or the panel stays hidden
